optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Financial Crime Data Analyst, Transaction Screening

professionalSummary.text: Analyses screening alert outcomes each week and proposes rule and list changes with expected alert volumes.
professionalSummary.witness: Financial crime data analyst in a bank's transaction screening team for three years, analysing the screening alert outcomes each week and proposing rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard, with packs filed in the screening governance repository.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard, with the packs filed in the screening governance repository.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented twenty-seven proposals to the screening governance forum, with forum minutes recording compliance members' challenges and forum decisions, including twenty-two approvals as presented and five amendments.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented twenty-seven proposals to the screening governance forum; the forum minutes record the compliance members' challenges on each and the forum's decision, with twenty-two proposals approved as presented and five amended.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated approved rule changes with the screening operations team through change notes, recording responsibility boundaries between the candidate and operations, with approvals remaining with the forum.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the approved rule changes with the screening operations team through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which were operations'; the approvals were the forum's.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented limitation sections and hand-over conditions for each change note.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each change note.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided two proposals with forum minutes and decisions, one monthly screening effectiveness pack, and one change note with limitation section, with governance repository references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two proposals with their forum minutes and decisions, one monthly screening effectiveness pack and one change note with its limitation section, with the governance repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Defends proposals in screening governance forum when compliance members challenge them.
skills.witness: Interviewer 2 note: when the panel's compliance member challenged the sample proposal's false-positive estimate, the candidate named the two months the estimate came from, gave the alert counts for each, stated which count she would use if the forum preferred the conservative one, and left the estimate range on the slide rather than changing the number.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's weekly analysis of alert outcomes, proposal of rule changes with expected volumes, preparation of monthly packs under standard, presentation of 27 proposals with forum minutes, coordination of changes with operations through change notes, documentation of limitations, and a sample of work. The materials do not establish the candidate's role in the forum's decision-making process beyond presenting proposals, nor the candidate's direct approval authority over rule changes.
